resolved_finding.category: explicit run port override blocked by SERVER_NAME port parsing
resolved_finding.technical_rationale: The head reads urlsplit(...).port before checking the explicit run port. With SERVER_NAME='localhost:65536', that property raises ValueError, so app.run(port=8000) cannot use the override. The base converted the configured port only when no explicit port was supplied.
resolved_finding.comment_usefulness_rationale: A focused comment would identify the changed override behavior and point to deferring configured-port validation until that port is needed.

pairings.rationale: The frozen diff directly supports B’s one-sided, low-severity regression finding. A supplied no finding to pair with it.

summary: One repository-supported regression: an invalid configured SERVER_NAME port now prevents app.run from using an explicit port override.
